title: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV)
question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.

prediction.sql:
WITH first_purchase AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(strftime('%s', payment_date)) AS first_ts
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING SUM(amount) > 0
),
sales_7d AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, SUM(p.amount) AS sales_7d
    FROM payment p
    JOIN first_purchase fp ON p.customer_id = fp.customer_id
    WHERE (strftime('%s', p.payment_date) - fp.first_ts) <= 7 * 24 * 3600
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
),
sales_30d AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, SUM(p.amount) AS sales_30d
    FROM payment p
    JOIN first_purchase fp ON p.customer_id = fp.customer_id
    WHERE (strftime('%s', p.payment_date) - fp.first_ts) <= 30 * 24 * 3600
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(s7.sales_7d * 100.0 / cl.total_ltv) AS avg_pct_7d,
    AVG(s30.sales_30d * 100.0 / cl.total_ltv) AS avg_pct_30d,
    AVG(cl.total_ltv) AS avg_ltv
FROM customer_ltv cl
JOIN sales_7d s7 ON cl.customer_id = s7.customer_id
JOIN sales_30d s30 ON cl.customer_id = s30.customer_id

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH cust AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(amount) AS ltv,
    MIN(payment_date) AS first_date
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
sales AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.ltv,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (julianday(p.payment_date) - julianday(c.first_date)) * 24 <= 7*24 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS s7,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (julianday(p.payment_date) - julianday(c.first_date)) * 24 <= 30*24 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS s30
  FROM cust c
  JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.ltv
)
SELECT
  AVG(s7 * 100.0 / ltv) AS avg_pct_7,
  AVG(s30 * 100.0 / ltv) AS avg_pct_30,
  AVG(ltv) AS avg_ltv
FROM sales
WHERE ltv > 0;
